title: Loss masks, turn-level credit, and a calculator agent
brief: Mask tool output out of the policy loss and prove its gradient is zero, compute turn-level and token-level returns, then train a tabular agent to use a calculator.
hints: loss_mask is (roles == AGENT) cast to a float. Tool outputs, the prompt, and padding are all observations, not actions.
masked_pg_loss divides by mask.sum(), the number of trained tokens in the whole batch. The gradient on a masked position is then exactly zero, because its log-prob is multiplied by 0.
turn_returns walks k from the last turn to the first: running = (r_k + gamma * running) * turn_mask[:, k]. token_level_returns is the same walk over positions, with no mask.
turn_to_token is turn_values.gather(1, turn.clamp(min=0)) * mask. The clamp only keeps the index valid; the mask zeroes those positions afterward.

In train_agent, play a batch with rollout, get turn returns, subtract the per-turn batch mean over episodes that reached that turn, broadcast with turn_to_token, and step Adam on masked_pg_loss of token_logprobs(theta, tokens, turn). Pass mask_tool_tokens=False by adding (roles == TOOL) to the mask.
